behaviors_covered.precision.bjt_mirror_base_current: Complete non-default Iref=1.28 mA / beta=62 oracle with two-base KCL and exact collector/base ratio; linear current scaling through 1e-200 with exact fractional deficit, inclusive margin==0 boundary and one-ulp-below rejection; beta=1000 preserves the 1/501 fractional deficit; every scalar invalid boundary and every NaN/+Inf/-Inf input followed by fully asserted valid recovery.
behaviors_covered.precision.instrumentation_internal_headr: Complete negative-differential oracle with final-stage node KCL on both difference-stage resistors; zero and reversed differential preserve the reference path; inclusive final-output and final-input-pin endpoints with one-ulp rejections; both hidden first-stage output clips rejected while both signal pins stay inside the common-mode interval; signal pins, final output and final pin each invalidated independently; every scalar invalid boundary and every NaN/+Inf/-Inf input followed by fully asserted valid recovery.
behaviors_covered.precision.transimpedance_butterworth: Complete wt*Rf*Cs=5 oracle with independent damping identity (1/wt+RfCf)^2 = 2Rf(Cs+Cf)/wt and -3 dB magnitude check at the returned bandwidth; exact 2 wt Rf Cs = 1 boundary admitted with Cf=0, bandwidth sqrt(2)*GBW and noise-gain zero 2/GBW, one-ulp-below rejection and one-ulp-above positive Cf; zero-signal and inclusive swing boundary with adjacent rejection and recovery; GBW=1000 unsolvable rejection; every scalar invalid boundary and every NaN/+Inf/-Inf input followed by fully asserted valid recovery.
behaviors_covered.precision.howland_mismatch_load: Complete mismatched-pump oracle with both node KCL equations and amplifier-current decomposition; balanced ratios remove load dependence of current but not output drive; negative, zero and reversed signed conductance admitted by symmetry; both polarities accept exact output/common-mode/current limits and reject each independent 1 percent excess with recovery; PRECISION-T1: exact decimal singularity with zero drive must reject (expected FAIL, see suspected defects); representable tiny positive total conductance 2^-61 retains the exact finite solution while exact and 4/3-singular neighbors reject; every scalar invalid boundary and every NaN/+Inf/-Inf input followed by fully asserted valid recovery.
behaviors_covered.precision.brokaw_first_order_trim: Complete T=320 K N=4 oracle from exact SI k and q with 2 I R1 = Vref-VBE, 2 (R1/R2) dVBE/T = |slope| zero-slope identities; area-ratio and R2 scaling laws keep the 1.186 V reference; N=1+epsilon admitted with series ln(1+eps) oracles and fractional N=1.5 admitted; local-temperature trajectory on the characterized VBE curve cancels the first-order slope and keeps R1 constant; every scalar invalid boundary including slope==0 and slope>0 and every NaN/+Inf/-Inf input followed by fully asserted valid recovery.
behaviors_covered.precision.log114_current_ratio: Complete 0.1-decade negative oracle with transimpedance identity dV/dI = 0.375/(ln10 I1); equal and one-ulp-adjacent currents retain the signed tiny output through exact Sterbenz differences; one-decade and reference-resistor scaling follow the 0.375 V/decade device law; PRECISION-T2: all four device range corners demand full log-ratio precision (expected FAIL at the 5e-8 ratio corner, see suspected defects); every scalar invalid boundary including 100 pA / 10 mA / 1250 ohm / 25 Gohm endpoints and every NaN/+Inf/-Inf input followed by fully asserted valid recovery.

oracle_provenance: Non-default vectors derived independently from node KCL, the documented two-pole closed-loop denominator, exact SI k=1.380649e-23 / q=1.602176634e-19, logarithm identities and binary64 Sterbenz/series analysis; confirmed against research/expansion/precision.md formulas, never against catalog example outputs. Suspected-defect reproductions T1/T2 verified by independent binary64 evaluation of the exact catalog expressions (guard total +2.7105054e-20; corner decades relative error 3.5e-11).
verification: Not executed. No builds, tests, lint, formatter, backend process or native launches. Independent arithmetic and source inspection only; all 27 Rust tests and 19 flat process scenarios await Main. Two authored tests (PRECISION-T1, PRECISION-T2) are expected to fail against current source by design and are listed as suspected defects.
untested_gaps: Main must compile and run the precision integration target and full integrated suite; the two PRECISION-T1/T2 reproduction tests are expected failures that gate the listed defects.

Main must run the flat scenarios in one real JSON-lines process and inspect the native desktop scenarios; nonfinite inputs are covered in the Rust suite only because scenario JSON must remain strictly valid JSON.
No device-level LOG114 conformity, instrumentation amplifier bandwidth/noise, transimpedance slew, Howland stability or bandgap curvature/startup validation.
No exhaustive binary64 domain sweep beyond the constructed boundary vectors.

suspected_defects.location: backend/catalog/precision.json constraint 'The loaded Howland feedback must have positive total conductance' (1/load_resistance+(1/r_one-(r_four/r_three)/r_two) > 0)
suspected_defects.evidence: Source-derived, not executed; reproduced by independent binary64 evaluation of the exact catalog expressions.
suspected_defects.contradiction: Exact decimal cancellation gives 1/RL+g = 1/5000 + 1/10000 - 3/10000 = 0, an indeterminate load-node equation, so the strict guard must reject. binary64 summation rounds the guard to +2.7105054e-20, the constraint passes, and the model silently returns the all-zero 'solution' with g=-2e-4 instead of reporting the singular bias point.
suspected_defects.minimal_correction: Evaluate the loaded-conductance guard with compensated/exact arithmetic or reject |total| <= eps*(1/load_resistance+|g|) before dividing; do not widen the bound into a heuristic that also hides genuine small-positive designs. Gated by backend/tests/precision.rs::howland_decimal_exact_singularity_rejects_even_with_zero_drive, which is expected to fail until fixed.

suspected_defects.evidence: Source-derived, not executed; reproduced by independent binary64 evaluation of the exact catalog expressions.
suspected_defects.contradiction: signal_current-reference_current cancels all but ~8 digits of the tiny signal (x=-0.99999995, absolute error ~1.1e-16), and d(log1p)/dx = 1/(1+x) amplifies it by 2e7, giving log_decades = -7.30102999541041, a 3.5e-11 relative error versus ln(5e-8)/ln(10) = -7.301029995663981; the device still specifies full accuracy at its 100 pA endpoint. Near-unity vectors are unaffected (Sterbenz-exact differences), so only log(ratio) computed from the isolated ratio fixes this without regressing the adjacent-current precision.
suspected_defects.minimal_correction: Compute log_decades from ln(signal_current/reference_current)/ln(10), or keep log1p but feed it the relative difference formed without the catastrophic subtraction; do not loosen the corner tolerance. Gated by backend/tests/precision.rs::log114_all_device_range_corners_keep_full_log_ratio_precision, which is expected to fail at this corner until fixed.

parent_desktop_scenarios.steps: Select the mirror calculator; enter the complete non-default vector; calculate; compare all five outputs and units against the independent KCL oracle. Then set collector_voltage to 0.6 (below VBE), confirm rejection, restore 1.9 without reopening the app and confirm recovery. Inspect diagram labels: Q1 collector/base short explicit, reference and output arrows downward, margin label bound to collector_voltage minus base_emitter_voltage.

Enter the negative-differential vector; compare all six node outputs. Then set common_voltage to 2.75 with common limits +/-3 and confirm the hidden first-stage clip rejects although the final output would fit; restore 2.0 and confirm recovery. Inspect diagram: floating gain resistor between the two first-stage minus pins, four-resistor difference stage, reference port and both internal branch outputs labeled with their exact keys.

Enter the wt*Rf*Cs=5 vector; compare all five outputs. Then set gain_bandwidth to 1000, confirm the unsolvable rejection, restore 1000000 and confirm recovery. Inspect diagram: current source into the grounded summing node, Cs shunting input, separate Rf/Cf branches to the output, signed DC transimpedance label.

Enter the mismatched two-drive vector; compare all six outputs including the signed conductance and amplifier current. Then set r_four to 40000, confirm the unstable rejection, restore 1800 and confirm recovery. Inspect diagram: R2 positive feedback meets the loaded Vx node, R4 negative feedback separate, signed load-current arrow out of Vx into the grounded load.

Enter the T=320 K N=4 vector; compare all six outputs against the exact-SI derivation. Then set area_ratio to 1, confirm the rejection, restore 4 and confirm recovery. Inspect diagram: unequal-area BJTs with shared bases, R2 between emitters, R1 carrying 2I to ground, servo amplifier between equal collector branches, reference node labeled reference_voltage.

Enter the 0.1-decade vector; compare all five outputs including the negative signed log output. Then set signal_current to 5e-11, confirm the below-range rejection, restore 2e-07 and confirm recovery. Inspect diagram: I1 receives the signal, VREF drives I2 through the external resistor, COM/VCM/VREF grounds and +/-5 V rails explicit, VLOGOUT label bound to log_output.
